CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

3. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   C. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.

   C. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   D. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   B. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
